themeMode.label: Active theme palette
themeMode.description: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting as it changes.

invertVerticalCoordinate.label: Invert vertical coordinate
invertVerticalCoordinate.description: Flip the battlefield rows top to bottom, so lands sit at the top of your side.

minPlayersForMultiColumnLayout.label: Minimum player count for multi-column layout

horizontalHand.label: Display hand horizontally (wastes space)
horizontalHand.description: Off, your hand is a column beside your life and zones, and every card in it stays in view.

leftJustifiedHand.label: Enable left justification
leftJustifiedHand.description: Starts a horizontal hand at the left instead of centring it.
